TABLE.NAME: quizgame
TABLE.COMMENT: Use the Quizventure module to give the students a fun way of learning.

FIELD.NAME: course
FIELD.COMMENT: Course quizgame activity belongs to

FIELD.NAME: name
FIELD.COMMENT: name field for moodle instances

FIELD.NAME: intro
FIELD.COMMENT: General introduction of the quizgame activity

FIELD.NAME: introformat
FIELD.COMMENT: Format of the intro field (MOODLE, HTML, MARKDOWN...)

FIELD.NAME: questioncategory
FIELD.COMMENT: The category from which to get the questions

FIELD.NAME: questioncategorysubcats
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether to also include questions from subcategories of questioncategory

FIELD.NAME: grade
FIELD.COMMENT: Grade scale

FIELD.NAME: gradepassingscore
FIELD.COMMENT: Game score that earns the maximum gradebook grade (0 = raw score)

FIELD.NAME: pointscorrect
FIELD.COMMENT: Points for a correct hit (multiplied by the answer's fraction)

FIELD.NAME: wrongpenalties
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated penalties for the 1st, 2nd, ... wrong hit in one question; the last value repeats

FIELD.NAME: misspenalty
FIELD.COMMENT: Points lost for a shot that hits nothing

FIELD.NAME: sassy
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether Sassy enhancements (cheater mode) are enabled

FIELD.NAME: sassywrongtrigger
FIELD.COMMENT: Wrong hits (across questions, reset by a clean question) that trigger cheater mode

FIELD.NAME: sassycleanneeded
FIELD.COMMENT: Clean questions needed to leave cheater mode

FIELD.NAME: sassybosslimit
FIELD.COMMENT: Offence number that starts the boss finale

FIELD.NAME: sassyreadtime
FIELD.COMMENT: Seconds the question is shown alone in a Read it first penalty

FIELD.NAME: sassypenalties
FIELD.COMMENT: Comma-separated keys of the enabled higher-tier penalties

FIELD.NAME: sassyorder
FIELD.COMMENT: Higher-tier penalty selection: 0 in order, 1 random

FIELD.NAME: sassymaxdecoys
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum number of decoy ships per question

FIELD.NAME: sassydrainrate
FIELD.COMMENT: Score drain start rate in points per second

FIELD.NAME: sassydrainincrease
FIELD.COMMENT: Score drain rate increase per further wrong hit, in percent

FIELD.NAME: sassybossstyle
FIELD.COMMENT: Boss finale style: 0 big boss, 1 swarm, 2 random

FIELD.NAME: sassyswarmsize
FIELD.COMMENT: Number of ships in a swarm boss finale

FIELD.NAME: sassytaunts
FIELD.COMMENT: Taunt messages, one per line (empty: built-in defaults)

FIELD.NAME: sassydecoylabels
FIELD.COMMENT: Decoy ship labels, one per line (empty: built-in defaults)

FIELD.NAME: sassybosslines
FIELD.COMMENT: Boss finale lines, one per line (empty: built-in defaults)

FIELD.NAME: rewards
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether rewards for good play are enabled

FIELD.NAME: rewardcombo
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the combo multiplier is enabled

FIELD.NAME: rewardmaxmult
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum combo multiplier

FIELD.NAME: rewardlife
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether extra lives are enabled

FIELD.NAME: rewardlifestreak
FIELD.COMMENT: Clean questions in a row per extra life

FIELD.NAME: rewardmaxlives
FIELD.COMMENT: Maximum number of lives

FIELD.NAME: rewardbonus
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether the bonus round is enabled

FIELD.NAME: rewardbonusstreak
FIELD.COMMENT: Clean questions in a row for a bonus round

FIELD.NAME: rewardbonuspoints
FIELD.COMMENT: Points per bonus ship (not multiplied)

FIELD.NAME: rewardpraise
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether praise messages are enabled

FIELD.NAME: rewardpraiselines
FIELD.COMMENT: Praise messages, one per line (empty: built-in defaults)

FIELD.NAME: rewardmissbreak
FIELD.COMMENT: Whether a miss resets the combo multiplier

FIELD.NAME: rewardbonusships
FIELD.COMMENT: Bonus ships per bonus round

FIELD.NAME: rewardbonusspeed
FIELD.COMMENT: Bonus ship speed, percent of the normal speed

FIELD.NAME: startlives
FIELD.COMMENT: Lives a game starts with

FIELD.NAME: speedramp
FIELD.COMMENT: Enemy speed-up per question, percent (0 = off)

FIELD.NAME: speedrampstart
FIELD.COMMENT: When the speed-up starts: 0 score target, 1 after the first round, 2 from the second question

FIELD.NAME: speedroundjump
FIELD.COMMENT: Enemy speed-up per new round, percent (0 = off)

FIELD.NAME: quizgameid
FIELD.COMMENT: The identifier of the quizgame instance on which this score was obtained.

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: The id of the user that achieved the score

FIELD.NAME: score
FIELD.COMMENT: The score the player got

KEY.NAME: userid
KEY.COMMENT: The id of the user that achieved the score
